About Koddi

 We are a global technology company with software and services that help top digital marketplaces effectively monetize their first-party audiences through industry-leading commerce media technology and strategy. Our enterprise platforms leverage first-party data to drive marketplace revenue and profit by improving user experience and target shoppers throughout the purchase path. Koddi’s platforms enable any advertiser, any marketplace, in any industry to increase awareness, generate demand, and drive revenue. We are committed to driving innovation and growth in the commerce media space.

  

 As part of that commitment, we’ve launched Koddi Academy, a learning platform designed to provide expert knowledge, competitive insights, and practical strategies for thriving in this fast-growing industry. Explore our latest certification course, to deepen your expertise and stay ahead in the evolving world of commerce media.

 
You can also sign up for our waiting list to be notified when new courses are released. Get started today at  Koddi Academy. 











 Associate Platform Engineer Cohort - Start Date February 15th, 2027 

 Koddi is excited to announce a Platform Engineering training program geared towards recent graduates with Computer Science, Information Technology, or related degrees, as well as recent grads who have completed coding bootcamps! The Koddi Cohort Program is an intensive 8-week training program that includes all aspects of Platform Engineering at Koddi. In addition to technical training during this program, and on an ongoing basis, we will also provide instructor-led and self-paced leadership development opportunities.

 
 Program Highlights: 

 
 Work alongside and learn directly from engineers with deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, and software delivery.

 Explore a broad technology stack spanning AWS and Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, observability, and data platforms.

 Gain hands-on experience with the systems behind a commerce media platform, where performance, reliability, and scale have real business impact.

 Experience a fast-moving engineering team: contribute to real projects, get frequent feedback, and take on greater responsibility as your skills grow.

 Build technical judgment through collaborative troubleshooting, design discussions, and opportunities to present your work.

 Develop communication and leadership skills through workshops, executive mentorship, and peer support.

 
 Please check out our KIP landing page for more information on the program. 

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Work alongside platform and product engineers to build, operate, and improve infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions.

 Write and improve infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, with guidance and code reviews from experienced engineers.

 Gain hands-on experience with containers and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure.

 Contribute to build and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and Kargo.

 Write scripts and automation that connect systems, reduce repetitive work, and make engineering teams more productive.

 Learn how databases, caches, and messaging systems support applications, and help investigate their performance and reliability.

 Use metrics, logs, and dashboards in tools such as Datadog to understand system behavior and troubleshoot issues across applications, infrastructure, and networking.

 Help deliver changes from development through production, learning how testing, observability, and rollback planning support safe, frequent releases.

 Participate in technical discussions, ask questions, share findings, and apply feedback as you tackle progressively more challenging work.

 
 What You'll Bring: 

 
 A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or completion of relevant coding bootcamp coursework by the program’s start date of February 15th 2027.

 Evidence of hands-on learning through internships, coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions, or coding competitions.

 Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Bash, or Go.

 Basic familiarity with Git, command-line tools, and Linux/Unix environments.

 Foundational knowledge of cloud computing, operating systems, or networking, and curiosity about how these systems work together.

 Exposure to AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, or CI/CD is a plus; you are not expected to know our entire stack.

 A methodical approach to problem-solving: investigate, test assumptions, ask for help, and explain what you find.

 An eagerness to learn from experienced engineers, seek feedback, and put new knowledge into practice.

 Comfort with a fast-moving, collaborative environment where you will learn unfamiliar technologies, adjust to changing priorities, and follow through on commitments.

 Availability to work onsite Monday–Friday in our Fort Worth office throughout the program and full-time after completing it.
